title: plt run state
description: A run's state.yaml. plt is the only writer, so an unknown top-level key is a defect, not a feature. Every key here is one lib/spine.js writes: launchRun writes run/cycle/status/formula_version/repo_dir/owner/created/estimate/pin/current_step/steps, stepStart claims owner_window, pollRun writes poll, closeRun writes closed/closed_as, gateCheck writes facts and discardRun writes exit.

poll.description: The last facts `plt run poll` saw, and when. A snapshot of GitHub's truth, not a status the spine owns.

estimate.description: What launchRun wrote: the estimate and the unit it is counted in (config.estimation.unit, default ideal_days). An estimate is never re-pointed, so this is written once.

receipts_required.description: What compileRequirements derived from the step. The kinds are the ledger's event kinds PLUS `overlap` and `effort` — those two are evaluated live at gateCheck (from the run's inputs and its effort file) and are never satisfied by a receipt, so they exist here and nowhere in the ledger.
